post.summary: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint: password and refresh_token grants (form encoded).

get.description: Newest first. Filter by target with ?targetId=.
Status of a long-running operation started by the caller (EVT-06).
Server-sent events for the caller: operation progress and other live notifications.
Open tasks across every task list the caller can read: view=mine (default), dueThisWeek, overdue or all. Dates are UTC; ordered by due date.
The feed ({token}.ics, no sign-in: the token names the organization and the feed). Shows what the owner can read now.
OData query options: $filter, $orderby, $top, $skiptoken, $count and $select (field names); viewId reads through a saved view.

patch.description: fields are merged (null removes a value); parentId moves the item (null: the list root); contentTypeId changes its content type. Requires If-Match.

get.description: Counts per value of a field (at most 200 values, most frequent first), of the items matching $filter.

post.description: Merges fields into every item matching filter, in the background: 202 with the operation to poll.

get.description: Without a token: all items, paged, then a deltaLink. With $deltatoken: the changes since.

post.description: Saves the version's values as a new change (validated, mutators and events run). Requires If-Match of the item.

delete.description: Deletes the item permanently (list managers only).

post.description: Provisions the extension's content types and grants its member scopes to the Member role.
Its endpoints, subscribers, mutators and jobs stop in this organization; data stays.

put.description: A new webhook URL creates a signing secret, returned once in webhookSecret. Quiet hours and the digest hour are local times in the user's time zone.

post.description: Follows a list or an item the caller can read; following again changes the frequency.
The URL must answer POST {url}?validationToken=… with 200 and the token as the body.

patch.description: Authors only; needs If-Match. Users newly mentioned are notified.

delete.description: Deletes the comment and its replies (the author, or someone with Manage on the item).

get.description: The item's timeline, newest first: changes, comments and entries of modules and extensions.
The note's wiki links in order, resolved to notes where possible.
Notes that link to this note, by title.

post.description: Links the task to another item: subtask (one parent per task), blockedBy or document. Cycles are rejected.

put.description: Makes the task repeat (RFC 5545 RRULE, e.g. FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=1); the task needs a due date.

post.description: Creates a task in a task list, linked to the document (e.g. "pay this invoice").

put.description: Makes the event repeat (RFC 5545 RRULE) in an IANA time zone (default: the caller's preferred time zone).
Moves or changes one occurrence (RECURRENCE-ID): it becomes its own event item with the series' values and the changes.

delete.description: Cancels one occurrence of a series (EXDATE).

post.description: Imports events from an iCalendar body (text/calendar, up to 10 MB) into an event list.

get.description: Events and due tasks between start and end (ISO 8601, at most 366 days) across every calendar and task list the caller can read.

post.description: A read-only subscription URL for calendar apps: one list, or all the caller's calendar and task lists. The URL contains a secret and is shown once.

AddLinkRequest.description: A link to add: `kind` is `subtask`, `blockedBy` or `document`.

AddNestedGroupRequest.description: A group to put inside another group: its members become members of that group too.

AddWorkspaceMemberRequest.description: Adds a member or changes their role: `owner`, `member` (the default) or `visitor`.

BulkUpdateRequest.description: Bulk update body: an OData filter (optional: all items) and field values to merge.

reminderMinutes.description: Minutes before the start to remind attendees (CAL-01, NTF-02).

CalendarEntry.description: An event occurrence or a due task in a time range (CAL-03).

ChangeSubscriptionRequest.description:
Create body. `resource` is `workspaces/{id}/lists/{id}/items` (the whole list) or `…/items/{id}` (one
item); `changeTypes` any of `created`, `updated`, `deleted`; `expirationDateTime` at most 30
days ahead (default: the maximum).

@odata.etag.description: The ETag for `If-Match` on changes (the same as the `ETag` header).

ChangeSubscriptionResponse.description: A change subscription; string? ChangeSubscriptionResponse.Secret is only returned when it is created (shown once).

ChangeSubscriptionUpdate.description: Renewal body: a new expiry and optionally a new client state.

ChannelChoice.description: Channel choice for one notification type.

CommentRequest.description: Create body: `{ "text", "parentId"?, "mentions"?: [userId] }`. Mentioned users are notified.

@odata.etag.description: The ETag for `If-Match` on changes (the same as the `ETag` header).

CommentUpdateRequest.description: Update body: `{ "text", "mentions"? }` (the reply target cannot change).

ContentTypeResponse.description: A content type. `key` is set when it comes from a template; `extensionId` when an extension manages it (read-only).

CreateItemRequest.description:
Create body: `{ "id"?, "contentTypeId"?, "parentId"?, "isFolder"?, "fields": { "title": …, … } }`. With
`id` the client chooses the item's id, so repeating a create is safe (the item it made is returned unchanged, 200).

CreateListRequest.description: A new list: `kind` is `list` (default) or `library`; `versioning``off` or `major`.

CreatedApiTokenResponse.description: Returned once, at creation: the only time the secret is visible.

DeltaItem.description: An entry of a delta page: an item, or only its id with `@removed`.

ExtensionContributions.description: What an extension contributes (for the catalog API).

ExtensionSetting.description: A tenant-level setting of an extension.

FeedResponse.description: A calendar feed; string? FeedResponse.Url (with the secret) is only returned when the feed is created.

ItemPage.description: A page of items in Graph/OData shape.

ItemResponse.description: A list item as returned by the API. `fields` contains `title` and all field values.

ItemVersionResponse.description: A version of an item; `fields` holds the values after that change (including `title`).

LinkedItem.description: Another item, as shown in links: only items the caller can read are listed.

LinkedNote.description: A note the caller can read.

ListResponse.description: A list with its content types and effective columns.

MyTask.description: A task in a cross-list view (TSK-03).

NoteLinkResponse.description: A wiki link of a note; LinkedNote? NoteLinkResponse.Note is the note it points to (left out when none exists or the caller cannot read it).

OccurrenceRequest.description: Changes for one occurrence: `fields` are merged over the series' values (e.g. a new `start`).

OperationAcceptedResponse.description: An operation that was started: poll `/v1.0/operations/{id}`.

PageOfActivityResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfAuditEntryDto.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfChangeSubscriptionResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfCommentResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfGroupResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfItemVersionResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfNotificationResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfRecycleBinItemResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfRunDto.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfUserResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfWorkflowDto.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PageOfWorkspaceResponse.description: A page of results in Graph/OData shape.

PermissionGrantDto.description:
A permission entry: `principalType` is `user`, `group`, `workspaceVisitors`,
`workspaceMembers` or `workspaceOwners`; for workspace roles the principal id is the workspace id.

PermissionsResponse.description:
Permissions of a list or item. `inheritsFrom` names where they come from: `workspace`, `list` or
`item` (with `inheritsFromId`), or null when unique. Grants are shown to managers only.

PreferencesResponse.description: Effective values, and which of them are inherited (from the organization's or the built-in defaults).

RoleAssignmentRequest.description: A role for a user or group; `principalType` is `user` or `group`.

SettingsRequest.description: Replaces the settings. Channels not listed use the defaults (in-app and webhook on).

@odata.etag.description: The ETag for `If-Match` on changes (the same as the `ETag` header).

SettingsResponse.description: Settings; string? SettingsResponse.WebhookSecret is only returned when a secret was created (shown once).

TaskFromDocumentRequest.description: Creates a task about a document (TSK-06): in `workspaceId`/`listId` (a task list).

UpdateGroupRequest.description: Changes to a group; an empty description removes it.

UpdateMeRequest.description: What users change on their own profile; the e-mail and user name are managed by administrators.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Changes to a user; an empty e-mail removes it, an empty display name falls back to the user name.

UpdateWorkspaceRequest.description: PATCH body: only the properties sent are changed.

ValueCount.description:
How many readable items have a value: the stored value as text (a choice, a number, a date, or a person, lookup
or term id), or null for items without one.

WorkspaceAccessLevel.description: What a user may do in a workspace. Ordered: higher includes lower. In JSON: `none`, `read`, …

WorkspaceResponse.description: A workspace and what the caller may do there (`manage` for owners and administrators, `contribute`, `read`).
